plan.title: New conversation on another machine shows this machine's working directory
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: In the new-conversation dialog, choosing a linked machine, Auto or Fly (new VM) in the Machine field leaves the disabled Working directory field showing this machine's project path (NewConversationDialog.tsx renders value={cwd} for every machine). That path does not exist on the chosen machine and is never sent: createFleetConversation copies only FLEET_FIELDS (no cwd), and the owner's work door resolves the directory from the project's gitOrigin. The start is correct; only the display is wrong.
narratives.Proposal: Add a pure machineCwdHint(machine, label, projectName) and a useMachineCwdHint hook (reusing MACHINES_QUERY_KEY) to MachineField.tsx. When the Machine field is not this machine, the dialog renders the Working directory input with value '' and the hint 'Set by <who>: its copy of <Project>' or 'Set by <who>: its default working directory' as placeholder and title, while keeping the cwd state so switching back restores it. Cover it in MachineField.test.tsx, including a fleet POST with no cwd key. Document the behavior in configuration/linked-machines.mdx and docs/ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md, and correct the machines-work.ts header (no-project default is getDefaultCwd, not home).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Listing, browsing or validating directories on another machine (the work door never takes a path; MachineProject is documented 'never a path')
- Sending a subdirectory or any cwd to another machine
- A dialog warning when the chosen machine lacks the project (the server already answers 404 project-missing with the add-project command)
- Any code change to the fleet route, the work door, the CLI --machine flags or the MCP start_conversation tool
- Clearing or rewriting the dialog's cwd state when the Machine field changes

autoDecisions.summary: Clear the field and explain instead of offering the chosen machine's paths.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists both readings. machines-work.ts states a caller never chooses a path on the owner, and packages/contracts MachineProject is documented 'never a path', so path offering would break the Anywhere design.

Verified: FLEET_FIELDS excludes cwd, the fleet route reads only machine/projectKey/model/harness/effort/issueId, and the work door starts in the matched project's checkout or getDefaultCwd(); fleet-conversations.test.ts ac10 already asserts the path-free work-door body.

autoDecisions.summary: Render-only fix that keeps the cwd state.
autoDecisions.rationale: Switching back to this machine should restore the operator's edited directory; clearing state would lose input for no gain.

autoDecisions.summary: Show the hint as the disabled input's placeholder and title.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the label bound to a control, reuses the existing .input::placeholder style, and adds no new layout.

autoDecisions.summary: The hook lives in MachineField.tsx and reuses MACHINES_QUERY_KEY; the label lookup ignores the online/hidden filter and falls back to 'the chosen machine'.
autoDecisions.rationale: React Query dedupes the request (no new fetch for the test network guard), and a link that drops offline after selection still shows its label.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. In MachineField.tsx add exported machineCwdHint(machine, label, projectName): null for machine ''; otherwise `Set by ${who}: ${projectName ? `its copy of ${projectName}` : 'its default working directory'}` where who is 'the machine Auto picks' for 'auto', 'the new Fly machine' for 'fly', else the label or 'the chosen machine'. Add exported useMachineCwdHint(choice, projectName) using useQuery({ queryKey: MACHINES_QUERY_KEY, queryFn: loadMachines, staleTime: 15_000 }) and (data?.links ?? []).find(link => link.environmentId === choice.machine)?.label ?? null. Extend the module header with one PAN-4872 sentence. In NewConversationDialog.tsx compute cwdHint = useMachineCwdHint(machine, project ? (project.name ?? project.key) : null) after the project useMemo, and set the Working directory input to value={cwdHint === null ? cwd : ''}, disabled={!projectKey || cwdHint !== null}, placeholder={cwdHint ?? (projectKey ? '' : 'Default working directory')}, title={cwdHint ?? undefined}. Do not touch setCwd, chooseProject, setMachine or payload code. Add the five tests listed in PRD WI-1 step 3 to MachineField.test.tsx using its existing fetch mock (project overdeck/Overdeck at /p/overdeck, link desk/env-desk).

items.title: Given project overdeck and Machine env-desk, the Working directory input renders an empty value, shows the hint text 'Set by desk: its copy of Overdeck', and is disabled (MachineField.test.tsx)

Auto with no project renders the hint text 'Set by the machine Auto picks: its default working directory'; Fly with project overdeck renders 'Set by the new Fly machine: its copy of Overdeck'; machineCwdHint('env-gone', null, 'Overdeck') returns 'Set by the chosen machine: its copy of Overdeck' and machineCwdHint('', 'x', 'y') returns null
When Create is clicked with Machine env-desk after editing the cwd, the single POST to /api/fleet/conversations has no cwd key and includes machine 'env-desk' and projectKey 'overdeck'
Document that the other machine sets the working directory
